steps.label: node
steps.script:
case "$(uname -m)" in
  x86_64) platform=linux-x64 sha256=361718c444e49af2ca5a110c83ba6a8901143f23ab285ebbef0341f391f482a9 ;;
  aarch64) platform=linux-arm64 sha256=95c264150aceb7f3437a29fd6984924f5f8d1511ea3cbd6c508b83f6c555dae2 ;;
  *) echo "unsupported architecture: $(uname -m)" >&2; exit 1 ;;
esac
curl -fsSL "https://nodejs.org/dist/v24.22.2/node-v24.22.2-$platform.tar.gz" -o /tmp/node.tar.gz
echo "$sha256  /tmp/node.tar.gz" | sha256sum -c -
rm -rf /usr/local/lib/node_modules/npm /usr/local/lib/node_modules/corepack
tar -xzf /tmp/node.tar.gz -C /usr/local --strip-components=1 --no-same-owner "node-v24.22.2-$platform/bin" "node-v24.22.2-$platform/include" "node-v24.22.2-$platform/lib" "node-v24.22.2-$platform/share"
rm -f /tmp/node.tar.gz
node --version

steps.label: grok
steps.script:
curl -fsSL https://x.ai/cli/install.sh | GROK_BIN_DIR=/usr/local/bin bash -s 1.0.70
cp -L /usr/local/bin/grok /usr/local/bin/grok.bin
mv -f /usr/local/bin/grok.bin /usr/local/bin/grok
rm -f /usr/local/bin/agent
rm -rf "$HOME/.grok"
grok --version

steps.label: antigravity
steps.script:
case "$(uname -m)" in
  x86_64) platform=linux-x64 archive=cli_linux_x64 sha512=ea01c73b772187bca928852cf96235f0d846d6da5ebdac188b9ae719597465737f325540d483ee5f3f62d151029001713344972a187ddfb98cc7b97f7204b7f4 ;;
  aarch64) platform=linux-arm archive=cli_linux_arm64 sha512=7cae317fb6a02eb387982f06bfb234b366879cf9a80ad8969b571e5a55d1e37a6a5a49cd6b703c0443bb417937cf5e3b14a8c80cb26917ad79eef723a9f374c7 ;;
  *) echo "unsupported architecture: $(uname -m)" >&2; exit 1 ;;
esac
curl -fsSL "https://storage.googleapis.com/antigravity-public/antigravity-cli/1.4.12-4768735748292608/$platform/$archive.tar.gz" -o /tmp/agy.tar.gz
echo "$sha512  /tmp/agy.tar.gz" | sha512sum -c -
tar -xzf /tmp/agy.tar.gz -C /usr/local/bin antigravity
mv /usr/local/bin/antigravity /usr/local/bin/agy
chmod +x /usr/local/bin/agy
rm /tmp/agy.tar.gz
agy --version
